headline: TBD
rule: Counts every House roll call on final disposition of a measure (passage, adopting a resolution, concurring in a Senate amendment, or suspending the rules and passing it) for which the White House issued a statement of administration policy that states a position on passage. Support means Trump wanted a Yea; opposition means a Nay. The rule applies to every member of either party; the votes that were examined but not counted, and why, are listed below.
why: Proposed headline thresholds, not yet approved: "Reliably with Trump" at 95% or more of counted votes cast with his position and with it on every vote where 10 or more of the member's own party voted the other way; "Mostly with Trump" at 80% to 94%; "Often against Trump" below 80%. The headline stays "Coming soon" until these are approved.
